    {"name": "adv_punctuality", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "Punctuality/reliability is a genuine operational facet of competitive advantage."},

  "facet_columns": ["adv_food", "adv_staff", "adv_seat_comfort", "adv_entertainment", "adv_value", "adv_lounge", "adv_punctuality", "adv_cleanliness"],

  "mutual_exclusivity": 0.85,
  "exhaustiveness": 0.8,
  "rationale": "Eight of the ten added columns are genuine part-of facets that carve airline competitive advantage into largely non-overlapping aspects (food, staff, seat comfort, entertainment, value, lounge, punctuality, cleanliness), covering most of the concept's main constitutive dimensions, though items like baggage handling, booking/website, or safety are absent. Mutual exclusivity is high but not perfect: value-for-money partially overlaps with the price/quality tradeoff implicit across the other quality facets. The two remaining columns (advantage_attribute_count, top_advantage_attribute) are scalar/meta restatements of the facet set rather than constitutive facets themselves, so they do not realise the faceted-decomposition claim."
}
